items.question: Trong câu "A data structure is a collection of values, the relationships among them, and the operations that can be applied to that data.", từ "collection" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A data structure is a collection of values, the relationships among them, and the operations that can be applied to that data.", what does "collection" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: collection /kəˈlekʃən/ (danh từ): tập hợp. "A collection of values" = một tập hợp các giá trị; nghĩa khác là việc thu gom, thu tiền.
items.explanationEn: collection /kəˈlekʃən/ (noun): a group of things. "A collection of values" is a group of values; it can also mean the act of collecting money.

items.question: Trong câu "A data structure is a collection of values, the relationships among them, and the operations that can be applied to that data.", từ "relationship" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A data structure is a collection of values, the relationships among them, and the operations that can be applied to that data.", what does "relationship" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: relationship /rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp/ (danh từ): mối quan hệ. "The relationships among values" = cách các giá trị liên hệ với nhau (vị trí, con trỏ, cha–con).
items.explanationEn: relationship /rɪˈleɪʃənʃɪp/ (noun): a connection. "The relationships among values" is how values are connected (by position, pointers, parent–child).

items.question: Trong câu "A data structure is a collection of values, the relationships among them, and the operations that can be applied to that data.", từ "apply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A data structure is a collection of values, the relationships among them, and the operations that can be applied to that data.", what does "apply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (động từ): áp dụng lên. "Apply to" = áp dụng cho; còn "apply for (a job)" = nộp đơn xin việc.
items.explanationEn: apply /əˈplaɪ/ (verb): to use on. "Apply to" means to use on something; "apply for (a job)" means to request formally.

items.question: Trong câu "An array relates values by position; a linked list relates them by next pointers; a tree relates them as parent and child; a graph lets anything connect to anything.", từ "relate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "An array relates values by position; a linked list relates them by next pointers; a tree relates them as parent and child; a graph lets anything connect to anything.", what does "relate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: relate /rɪˈleɪt/ (động từ): liên kết. "Relate A by B" = liên kết A theo cách B; "relate a story" lại có nghĩa là kể lại.
items.explanationEn: relate /rɪˈleɪt/ (verb): to connect. "Relate A by B" means to connect A in way B; "relate a story" means to narrate it.

items.question: Trong câu "Each one makes some operations cheap by making others expensive:", từ "expensive" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Each one makes some operations cheap by making others expensive:", what does "expensive" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: expensive /ɪkˈspensɪv/ (tính từ): tốn tài nguyên. Trong DSA, thao tác "expensive" là tốn nhiều thời gian/bộ nhớ, trái nghĩa với "cheap".
items.explanationEn: expensive /ɪkˈspensɪv/ (adjective): costly to run. In DSA an "expensive" operation costs a lot of time or memory; the opposite is "cheap".

items.question: Trong câu "You already use several of these without noticing (the DOM is a tree, the call stack is a stack), and interviewers expect you to pick the right one and justify it with Big O.", từ "notice" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You already use several of these without noticing (the DOM is a tree, the call stack is a stack), and interviewers expect you to pick the right one and justify it with Big O.", what does "notice" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: notice /ˈnəʊtɪs/ (động từ): nhận ra. "Without noticing" = mà không hề để ý; danh từ "notice" còn có nghĩa là thông báo.
items.explanationEn: notice /ˈnəʊtɪs/ (verb): to become aware of. "Without noticing" means without being aware of it; the noun "notice" can mean an announcement.

items.question: Trong câu "You already use several of these without noticing (the DOM is a tree, the call stack is a stack), and interviewers expect you to pick the right one and justify it with Big O.", từ "expect" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You already use several of these without noticing (the DOM is a tree, the call stack is a stack), and interviewers expect you to pick the right one and justify it with Big O.", what does "expect" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: expect /ɪkˈspekt/ (động từ): kỳ vọng. "Expect someone to do something" = mong đợi ai đó làm gì; nhà tuyển dụng kỳ vọng bạn chọn đúng cấu trúc.
items.explanationEn: expect /ɪkˈspekt/ (verb): to anticipate. "Expect someone to do something" means to anticipate they will do it; interviewers expect the right choice.

items.question: Trong câu "You already use several of these without noticing (the DOM is a tree, the call stack is a stack), and interviewers expect you to pick the right one and justify it with Big O.", từ "justify" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "You already use several of these without noticing (the DOM is a tree, the call stack is a stack), and interviewers expect you to pick the right one and justify it with Big O.", what does "justify" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (động từ): chứng minh hợp lý. "Justify a choice" = đưa ra lý lẽ bảo vệ lựa chọn; trong soạn thảo văn bản "justify" là căn đều hai lề.
items.explanationEn: justify /ˈdʒʌstɪfaɪ/ (verb): to show it is right. "Justify a choice" means to give reasons it is right; in word processing "justify" means to align text evenly.

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript only ships a few built-ins (Array, Object, Map, Set), so for the rest of this course we build our own — and the tool we build them with is the class.", từ "ship" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript only ships a few built-ins (Array, Object, Map, Set), so for the rest of this course we build our own — and the tool we build them with is the class.", what does "ship" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: ship /ʃɪp/ (động từ): cung cấp sẵn. Trong phần mềm, "ship" = phát hành, đi kèm sẵn ("ships with"); nghĩa gốc là vận chuyển bằng tàu.
items.explanationEn: ship /ʃɪp/ (verb): to include by default. In software "ship" means to release or include ("ships with"); the original sense is to send by boat.

items.question: Trong câu "A class is a blueprint for creating objects with pre-defined properties and methods.", từ "blueprint" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A class is a blueprint for creating objects with pre-defined properties and methods.", what does "blueprint" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: blueprint /ˈbluːprɪnt/ (danh từ): bản thiết kế. "A blueprint for something" = bản thiết kế/khuôn mẫu để tạo ra thứ gì đó; class là khuôn để tạo object.
items.explanationEn: blueprint /ˈbluːprɪnt/ (noun): a design template. "A blueprint for something" is a plan used to create it; a class is the template for objects.

items.question: Trong câu "A class is a blueprint for creating objects with pre-defined properties and methods.", từ "pre-defined" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A class is a blueprint for creating objects with pre-defined properties and methods.", what does "pre-defined" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: pre-defined /ˌpriːdɪˈfaɪnd/ (tính từ): được định sẵn. Tiền tố "pre-" = trước; "pre-defined properties" là các thuộc tính đã được định nghĩa từ trước.
items.explanationEn: pre-defined /ˌpriːdɪˈfaɪnd/ (adjective): set in advance. The prefix "pre-" means before; "pre-defined properties" are defined ahead of time.

items.question: Trong câu "Every object created from it is called an instance.", từ "instance" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Every object created from it is called an instance.", what does "instance" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (danh từ): đối tượng cụ thể. Trong OOP, "instance" là một đối tượng tạo từ class; cụm "for instance" lại nghĩa là "ví dụ".
items.explanationEn: instance /ˈɪnstəns/ (noun): a concrete object. In OOP an "instance" is one object made from a class; "for instance" means "for example".

items.question: Trong câu "JavaScript is prototype-based: objects inherit directly from other objects.", từ "inherit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "JavaScript is prototype-based: objects inherit directly from other objects.", what does "inherit" (verb) mean?
optionsEn: to take on from a parent
items.explanation: inherit /ɪnˈherɪt/ (động từ): kế thừa. "Inherit from" = kế thừa từ; đời thường còn là thừa hưởng tài sản từ cha mẹ.
items.explanationEn: inherit /ɪnˈherɪt/ (verb): to take on from a parent. "Inherit from" means to receive traits from a parent; in daily life, to receive property from family.

items.question: Trong câu "The ES2015 class keyword is mostly syntactic sugar over constructor functions and prototypes:", từ "syntactic sugar" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The ES2015 class keyword is mostly syntactic sugar over constructor functions and prototypes:", what does "syntactic sugar" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: syntactic sugar /sɪnˈtæktɪk ˈʃʊɡə/ (cụm từ): cú pháp viết gọn. "Syntactic sugar over X" = cách viết dễ đọc hơn nhưng bên dưới vẫn là X.
items.explanationEn: syntactic sugar /sɪnˈtæktɪk ˈʃʊɡə/ (phrase): a nicer way to write. "Syntactic sugar over X" is a nicer way to write something that still works like X underneath.

items.question: Trong câu ""Mostly" sugar, because classes add real rules: the body always runs in strict mode, methods are non-enumerable, and a class cannot be called without new.", từ "strict" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Mostly" sugar, because classes add real rules: the body always runs in strict mode, methods are non-enumerable, and a class cannot be called without new.", what does "strict" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: strict /strɪkt/ (tính từ): nghiêm ngặt. "Strict mode" = chế độ nghiêm ngặt, bắt lỗi chặt hơn; "a strict teacher" = giáo viên nghiêm khắc.
items.explanationEn: strict /strɪkt/ (adjective): tightly enforced. "Strict mode" enforces rules more tightly; "a strict teacher" is one who allows little freedom.

items.question: Trong câu ""Mostly" sugar, because classes add real rules: the body always runs in strict mode, methods are non-enumerable, and a class cannot be called without new.", từ "enumerable" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence ""Mostly" sugar, because classes add real rules: the body always runs in strict mode, methods are non-enumerable, and a class cannot be called without new.", what does "enumerable" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: enumerable /ɪˈnjuːmərəbl/ (tính từ): có thể liệt kê. "Non-enumerable" = không hiện ra khi liệt kê (vd. vòng for...in); động từ gốc "enumerate" = liệt kê.
items.explanationEn: enumerable /ɪˈnjuːmərəbl/ (adjective): able to be listed. "Non-enumerable" means not shown when listing keys (e.g. for...in); the verb "enumerate" means to list.

items.question: Trong câu "The method that initialises a new object must be named constructor.", từ "initialise" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The method that initialises a new object must be named constructor.", what does "initialise" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: initialise /ɪˈnɪʃəlaɪz/ (động từ): khởi tạo. "Initialise an object" = khởi tạo, gán giá trị ban đầu; kiểu Mỹ viết "initialize".
items.explanationEn: initialise /ɪˈnɪʃəlaɪz/ (verb): to set up initially. "Initialise an object" means to give it starting values; American spelling is "initialize".

items.question: Trong câu "A method called init or Student is just an ordinary method and never runs automatically.", từ "ordinary" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A method called init or Student is just an ordinary method and never runs automatically.", what does "ordinary" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: ordinary /ˈɔːdənri/ (tính từ): bình thường. "Just an ordinary method" = chỉ là một phương thức bình thường, không có vai trò đặc biệt.
items.explanationEn: ordinary /ˈɔːdənri/ (adjective): plain, normal. "Just an ordinary method" is a normal method with no special role.

items.question: Trong câu "A method called init or Student is just an ordinary method and never runs automatically.", từ "automatically" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A method called init or Student is just an ordinary method and never runs automatically.", what does "automatically" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: automatically /ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli/ (trạng từ): một cách tự động. "Run automatically" = tự chạy mà không cần gọi; trái nghĩa là "manually".
items.explanationEn: automatically /ˌɔːtəˈmætɪkli/ (adverb): by itself. "Run automatically" means to run without being called; the opposite is "manually".

items.question: Trong câu "If you omit it, JavaScript supplies an empty one.", từ "omit" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you omit it, JavaScript supplies an empty one.", what does "omit" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: omit /əˈmɪt/ (động từ): lược bỏ. "Omit something" = bỏ không viết; danh từ là "omission" (sự bỏ sót).
items.explanationEn: omit /əˈmɪt/ (verb): to leave out. "Omit something" means to leave it out; the noun is "omission".

items.question: Trong câu "If you omit it, JavaScript supplies an empty one.", từ "supply" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "If you omit it, JavaScript supplies an empty one.", what does "supply" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (động từ): cung cấp. "Supply something" = cung cấp; JavaScript tự cung cấp một constructor rỗng nếu bạn không viết.
items.explanationEn: supply /səˈplaɪ/ (verb): to provide. "Supply something" means to provide it; JavaScript provides an empty constructor if you skip it.

items.question: Trong câu "The syntax is class Name { … } — no parentheses after the name.", từ "parenthesis" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The syntax is class Name { … } — no parentheses after the name.", what does "parenthesis" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: parenthesis /pəˈrenθəsɪs/ (danh từ): dấu ngoặc đơn ( ). Số nhiều "parentheses" = cặp ngoặc tròn; "braces" là ngoặc nhọn, "brackets" là ngoặc vuông.
items.explanationEn: parenthesis /pəˈrenθəsɪs/ (noun): round brackets ( ). The plural "parentheses" means round brackets; "braces" are curly and "brackets" are square.

items.question: Trong câu "Methods are not separated by commas (unlike an object literal).", từ "separate" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Methods are not separated by commas (unlike an object literal).", what does "separate" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (động từ): phân tách. "Separated by commas" = được ngăn cách bằng dấu phẩy; tính từ "separate" (/ˈsepərət/) = riêng biệt.
items.explanationEn: separate /ˈsepəreɪt/ (verb): to divide apart. "Separated by commas" means divided by commas; the adjective "separate" (/ˈsepərət/) means distinct.

items.question: Trong câu "Methods are not separated by commas (unlike an object literal).", từ "literal" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Methods are not separated by commas (unlike an object literal).", what does "literal" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: literal /ˈlɪtərəl/ (danh từ): giá trị viết trực tiếp. "Object literal" = object viết thẳng bằng { }; tính từ "literal" đời thường = theo nghĩa đen.
items.explanationEn: literal /ˈlɪtərəl/ (noun): a value written directly. An "object literal" is an object written directly with { }; the adjective "literal" means word-for-word.

items.question: Trong câu "A class declaration is hoisted but stays in the temporal dead zone: using it before its line throws a ReferenceError.", từ "hoist" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A class declaration is hoisted but stays in the temporal dead zone: using it before its line throws a ReferenceError.", what does "hoist" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: hoist /hɔɪst/ (động từ): đưa lên đầu phạm vi. "Hoisting" trong JS = khai báo được đưa lên đầu phạm vi; nghĩa gốc là kéo lên (vd. "hoist a flag").
items.explanationEn: hoist /hɔɪst/ (verb): to move to scope top. In JS "hoisting" moves declarations to the top of scope; originally it means to lift, as in "hoist a flag".

items.question: Trong câu "A class declaration is hoisted but stays in the temporal dead zone: using it before its line throws a ReferenceError.", từ "temporal" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A class declaration is hoisted but stays in the temporal dead zone: using it before its line throws a ReferenceError.", what does "temporal" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: temporal /ˈtempərəl/ (tính từ): liên quan thời gian. "Temporal dead zone" = vùng chết theo thời gian: khoảng từ đầu phạm vi đến dòng khai báo.
items.explanationEn: temporal /ˈtempərəl/ (adjective): related to time. "Temporal dead zone" is the time span from the start of scope until the declaration line runs.

items.question: Trong câu "A class declaration is hoisted but stays in the temporal dead zone: using it before its line throws a ReferenceError.", từ "declaration" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A class declaration is hoisted but stays in the temporal dead zone: using it before its line throws a ReferenceError.", what does "declaration" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: declaration /ˌdekləˈreɪʃən/ (danh từ): sự khai báo. "Class declaration" = câu lệnh khai báo class; đời thường "declaration" là lời tuyên bố.
items.explanationEn: declaration /ˌdekləˈreɪʃən/ (noun): a definition in code. A "class declaration" is the statement that defines a class; generally it means a formal announcement.

items.question: Trong câu "Create a brand-new empty object.", từ "brand-new" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Create a brand-new empty object.", what does "brand-new" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: brand-new /ˌbrænd ˈnjuː/ (tính từ): hoàn toàn mới. "Brand-new" nhấn mạnh là mới tinh, chưa từng tồn tại trước đó.
items.explanationEn: brand-new /ˌbrænd ˈnjuː/ (adjective): completely new. "Brand-new" stresses that something is totally new and never existed before.

items.question: Trong câu "Return the object (unless the constructor explicitly returns a different object).", từ "explicitly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Return the object (unless the constructor explicitly returns a different object).", what does "explicitly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (trạng từ): một cách tường minh. "Explicitly return" = viết rõ câu lệnh return; trái nghĩa là "implicitly" (ngầm định).
items.explanationEn: explicitly /ɪkˈsplɪsɪtli/ (adverb): clearly and directly. "Explicitly return" means to write the return statement out; the opposite is "implicitly".

items.question: Trong câu "Calling Student("Ada", "Lovelace") without new throws TypeError: Class constructor Student cannot be invoked without 'new'.", từ "invoke" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Calling Student("Ada", "Lovelace") without new throws TypeError: Class constructor Student cannot be invoked without 'new'.", what does "invoke" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: invoke /ɪnˈvəʊk/ (động từ): gọi thực thi. "Invoke a function" = gọi hàm; trong văn pháp lý "invoke a right" = viện dẫn một quyền.
items.explanationEn: invoke /ɪnˈvəʊk/ (verb): to call and run. "Invoke a function" means to call it; in legal text "invoke a right" means to cite it.

items.question: Trong câu "The cost of calling a method is simply the cost of the work inside it: addScore is O(1) amortised, while average is O(n) in the number of scores.", từ "amortised" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The cost of calling a method is simply the cost of the work inside it: addScore is O(1) amortised, while average is O(n) in the number of scores.", what does "amortised" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: amortised /əˈmɔːtaɪzd/ (tính từ): tính bình quân dài hạn. "O(1) amortised" = trung bình O(1) khi xét nhiều lần gọi, dù đôi lúc một lần gọi tốn hơn.
items.explanationEn: amortised /əˈmɔːtaɪzd/ (adjective): averaged over many calls. "O(1) amortised" means O(1) on average across many calls, even if one call is sometimes slower.

items.question: Trong câu "In data-structure classes, the constructor sets up default properties and instance methods are the operations — push, pop, insert, find — whose Big O we analyse.", từ "default" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In data-structure classes, the constructor sets up default properties and instance methods are the operations — push, pop, insert, find — whose Big O we analyse.", what does "default" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (tính từ): mặc định. "Default properties" = thuộc tính có giá trị ban đầu; trong tài chính "default" là vỡ nợ.
items.explanationEn: default /dɪˈfɔːlt/ (adjective): used unless changed. "Default properties" have starting values unless changed; in finance "default" means failing to repay.

items.question: Trong câu "In data-structure classes, the constructor sets up default properties and instance methods are the operations — push, pop, insert, find — whose Big O we analyse.", từ "analyse" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "In data-structure classes, the constructor sets up default properties and instance methods are the operations — push, pop, insert, find — whose Big O we analyse.", what does "analyse" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: analyse /ˈænəlaɪz/ (động từ): phân tích. "Analyse the Big O" = phân tích độ phức tạp; danh từ là "analysis".
items.explanationEn: analyse /ˈænəlaɪz/ (verb): to examine closely. "Analyse the Big O" means to examine the complexity; the noun is "analysis".

items.question: Trong câu "A static member belongs to the class itself, not to instances.", từ "belong" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "A static member belongs to the class itself, not to instances.", what does "belong" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: belong /bɪˈlɒŋ/ (động từ): thuộc về. "Belong to" = thuộc về; static member thuộc về class chứ không thuộc từng instance.

items.explanation: composition /ˌkɒmpəˈzɪʃən/ (danh từ): sự kết hợp. "Composition" trong OOP = class chứa đối tượng khác bên trong; "a composition" cũng là một tác phẩm nhạc.
items.explanationEn: composition /ˌkɒmpəˈzɪʃən/ (noun): combining parts. In OOP "composition" means a class holding other objects; "a composition" is also a piece of music.

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly every structure ahead follows the same two-class pattern: a small node class holding a value plus links, and a container class holding entry points and a size.", từ "nearly" (trạng từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly every structure ahead follows the same two-class pattern: a small node class holding a value plus links, and a container class holding entry points and a size.", what does "nearly" (adverb) mean?
items.explanation: nearly /ˈnɪəli/ (trạng từ): gần như. "Nearly every" = gần như mọi; đồng nghĩa với "almost every".
items.explanationEn: nearly /ˈnɪəli/ (adverb): almost. "Nearly every" means almost every.

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly every structure ahead follows the same two-class pattern: a small node class holding a value plus links, and a container class holding entry points and a size.", từ "container" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly every structure ahead follows the same two-class pattern: a small node class holding a value plus links, and a container class holding entry points and a size.", what does "container" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: container /kənˈteɪnə/ (danh từ): đối tượng chứa. "Container class" = lớp chứa các nút và con trỏ; nghĩa gốc là thùng chứa, container hàng hoá.
items.explanationEn: container /kənˈteɪnə/ (noun): a holder of items. A "container class" holds the nodes and pointers; the original sense is a box for goods.

items.question: Trong câu "Nearly every structure ahead follows the same two-class pattern: a small node class holding a value plus links, and a container class holding entry points and a size.", từ "entry point" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Nearly every structure ahead follows the same two-class pattern: a small node class holding a value plus links, and a container class holding entry points and a size.", what does "entry point" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: entry point /ˈentri pɔɪnt/ (cụm từ): điểm bắt đầu truy cập. "Entry points" = nơi bắt đầu đi vào cấu trúc, vd. head và tail của danh sách liên kết.
items.explanationEn: entry point /ˈentri pɔɪnt/ (phrase): where access starts. "Entry points" are where you start accessing a structure, such as a list's head and tail.

items.question: Trong câu "push is O(1) time and O(1) space because the tail pointer avoids walking the list.", từ "avoid" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "push is O(1) time and O(1) space because the tail pointer avoids walking the list.", what does "avoid" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (động từ): tránh được. "Avoid + V-ing" = tránh làm gì; con trỏ tail giúp tránh phải duyệt cả danh sách.
items.explanationEn: avoid /əˈvɔɪd/ (verb): to keep from doing. "Avoid + -ing" means to keep from doing something; the tail pointer saves walking the list.

items.question: Trong câu "Storing length as a field makes size O(1); counting nodes on demand would be O(n).", từ "on demand" (cụm từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Storing length as a field makes size O(1); counting nodes on demand would be O(n).", what does "on demand" (phrase) mean?
items.explanation: on demand /ɒn dɪˈmɑːnd/ (cụm từ): khi được yêu cầu. "On demand" = chỉ làm khi có yêu cầu; vd. "video on demand" = xem video theo yêu cầu.
items.explanationEn: on demand /ɒn dɪˈmɑːnd/ (phrase): when requested. "On demand" means done only when asked for, as in "video on demand".

items.question: Trong câu "The same shape reappears as TreeNode { value, left, right } with a BinarySearchTree { root }, and as a Graph { adjacencyList }.", từ "reappear" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "The same shape reappears as TreeNode { value, left, right } with a BinarySearchTree { root }, and as a Graph { adjacencyList }.", what does "reappear" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: reappear /ˌriːəˈpɪə/ (động từ): xuất hiện lại. Tiền tố "re-" = lại; "reappear" = xuất hiện lại, trái nghĩa "disappear".
items.explanationEn: reappear /ˌriːəˈpɪə/ (verb): to show up again. The prefix "re-" means again; "reappear" means to show up again, opposite of "disappear".

items.question: Trong câu "Big O reminders for classes: creating an instance with a constant-work constructor is O(1); each instance costs memory for its own fields; methods on the prototype are shared; and a method's complexity is whatever its body does.", từ "reminder" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O reminders for classes: creating an instance with a constant-work constructor is O(1); each instance costs memory for its own fields; methods on the prototype are shared; and a method's complexity is whatever its body does.", what does "reminder" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: reminder /rɪˈmaɪndə/ (danh từ): điều cần ghi nhớ. "Big O reminders" = những điểm cần nhớ về Big O; đừng nhầm với "remainder" (phần dư).
items.explanationEn: reminder /rɪˈmaɪndə/ (noun): a note to remember. "Big O reminders" are points to remember; do not confuse it with "remainder" (a leftover part).

items.question: Trong câu "Big O reminders for classes: creating an instance with a constant-work constructor is O(1); each instance costs memory for its own fields; methods on the prototype are shared; and a method's complexity is whatever its body does.", từ "complexity" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Big O reminders for classes: creating an instance with a constant-work constructor is O(1); each instance costs memory for its own fields; methods on the prototype are shared; and a method's complexity is whatever its body does.", what does "complexity" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (danh từ): độ phức tạp tính toán. "Time complexity" = độ phức tạp thời gian (Big O); đời thường "complexity" là sự rắc rối.
items.explanationEn: complexity /kəmˈpleksəti/ (noun): cost as input grows. "Time complexity" is how cost grows with input (Big O); generally it means being complicated.

items.question: Trong câu "Different data structures excel at different operations, so we implement many of them — as classes.", từ "excel" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Different data structures excel at different operations, so we implement many of them — as classes.", what does "excel" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: excel /ɪkˈsel/ (động từ): vượt trội. "Excel at something" = rất giỏi, vượt trội ở việc gì; tính từ là "excellent".
items.explanationEn: excel /ɪkˈsel/ (verb): to be very good. "Excel at something" means to be very good at it; the adjective is "excellent".

items.question: Trong câu "Different data structures excel at different operations, so we implement many of them — as classes.", từ "implement" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Different data structures excel at different operations, so we implement many of them — as classes.", what does "implement" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (động từ): hiện thực bằng mã. "Implement a data structure" = viết mã hiện thực nó; danh từ "implement" (/ˈɪmplɪmənt/) là dụng cụ.
items.explanationEn: implement /ˈɪmplɪment/ (verb): to build in code. "Implement a data structure" means to build it in code; the noun "implement" (/ˈɪmplɪmənt/) is a tool.

items.question: Trong câu "Abstraction hides how; encapsulation protects state (#private fields) and keeps invariants like head/tail/length consistent.", từ "consistent" (tính từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Abstraction hides how; encapsulation protects state (#private fields) and keeps invariants like head/tail/length consistent.", what does "consistent" (adjective) mean?
items.explanation: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (tính từ): nhất quán. "Keep X consistent" = giữ X khớp nhau, không mâu thuẫn; danh từ là "consistency".
items.explanationEn: consistent /kənˈsɪstənt/ (adjective): in agreement. "Keep X consistent" means keeping the parts in agreement; the noun is "consistency".

items.question: Trong câu "this depends on how a method is called; detached methods lose it — fix with an arrow wrapper or bind.", từ "depend" (động từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "this depends on how a method is called; detached methods lose it — fix with an arrow wrapper or bind.", what does "depend" (verb) mean?
items.explanation: depend /dɪˈpend/ (động từ): phụ thuộc vào. "Depend on" = phụ thuộc vào; "you can depend on me" = bạn có thể tin cậy tôi.
items.explanationEn: depend /dɪˈpend/ (verb): to be decided by. "Depend on" means to be decided by; "you can depend on me" means you can trust me.

items.question: Trong câu "Polymorphism: same method name, different behaviour (a stack and a queue both remove).", từ "behaviour" (danh từ) nghĩa là gì?
items.questionEn: In the sentence "Polymorphism: same method name, different behaviour (a stack and a queue both remove).", what does "behaviour" (noun) mean?
items.explanation: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə/ (danh từ): cách hoạt động. "Different behaviour" = cách hoạt động khác nhau; với người, "behaviour" là cách cư xử. Kiểu Mỹ viết "behavior".
items.explanationEn: behaviour /bɪˈheɪvjə/ (noun): how it works. "Different behaviour" means working differently; for people it means conduct. American spelling is "behavior".
